intro: Across the city. Or on to your next adventure. Find your connection and go your own way.
heroAlt: A red tram, train and bus in an illustrated city
strip: From A to B. And everything in between.
stepsIntro: You choose the destination. TRAM helps with the journey.
step1: Enter a stop, pick a place on the map or use your current location.
step2: Compare times, duration and transfers. Open a journey to see the details.
step3: See live information where the operator provides it. Your search stays available after a refresh.
featureTag: The city is just the beginning
featureTitle:
Something new
is just around the bend.
featureText: We are building one place for journeys across town and beyond. Coverage grows as more transport sources become available.
featureAlt: A red train on a viaduct between green hills and a fjord
answer1: Availability depends on connected transport sources. If your journey is outside our coverage, the results will say so.
answer2: Operator data is fetched online first. Backup timetables are clearly labelled. A vehicle position is only shown when it is current.
answer3: For now, you can search and explore journeys. Ticket purchases are planned for a future stage.
privacy: We do not store your GPS location.
aboutTitle: A simple way to get going.
aboutText: TRAM brings available transport sources into one clear journey search. We are starting with the first regions and gradually adding cities, operators and countries.
